extracted.name: Soup maker carrot and coriander soup
extracted.description: Blend this comforting and colourful carrot and coriander soup recipe in a soup maker. Serve straight away with crusty bread or freeze it
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients into the soup maker, except the coriander, and press the ‘smooth soup’ function. Make sure you don’t fill the soup maker above the max fill line.
Once the cycle is complete, season and add the coriander. Blend once again until the coriander is mixed well and serve.
